root_cause.text: The NCI notification parsers in net/nfc/nci/ntf.c validated skb lengths against sizeof(struct) for messages containing variable-length trailing fields, so variable-length packet data was mis-sized and later parsed without field-by-field bounds checks.
root_cause.evidence: The fix replaces checks like `skb->len < sizeof(struct nci_rf_discover_ntf)` and `sizeof(struct nci_core_conn_credit_ntf)` with `offsetofend(...)` plus explicit length calculations using runtime fields such as `num_entries`, `rf_tech_specific_params_len`, and `activation_params_len`, and adds per-extractor `data_len` checks before reading variable-length parameters; the commit message explicitly says the prior code “failed to understand that in some cases the data packet is of variable length and can therefore not be compared to the maximum packet length given by the sizeof(struct).`

intent_record.intent_summary: Fix the packet length validation to require only the fixed header through num_entries so valid variable-length NCI credit notifications are not rejected.
intent_record.what: The length check in nci_core_conn_credits_ntf_packet() was changed from requiring skb->len to be at least sizeof(struct nci_core_conn_credit_ntf) to requiring it to be at least offsetofend(struct nci_core_conn_credit_ntf, num_entries).
intent_record.how: At runtime, the function now accepts packets that are large enough to contain the structure fields only up to and including num_entries, instead of rejecting them unless they match the full struct size. This prevents valid shorter notification packets from being incorrectly treated as invalid when the struct includes a flexible or variable-length trailing portion.

intent_record.intent_summary: Add a packet length check to reject truncated connection credit notifications before parsing their entries.
intent_record.what: A new length validation was added before processing connection credit notification entries: the code now checks whether skb->len is smaller than the offset through num_entries plus ntf->num_entries times sizeof(struct conn_credit_entry), and returns -EINVAL if the packet is too short.
intent_record.how: This prevents the loop that updates credits from reading past the end of the received skb when num_entries indicates more conn_credit_entry records than are actually present in the packet, causing malformed or truncated notifications to be rejected safely.

intent_record.intent_summary: Add input length validation to NFCA passive poll parameter parsing to safely reject short buffers with -EINVAL.
intent_record.what: The function nci_extract_rf_params_nfca_passive_poll() was changed to take an additional ssize_t data_len parameter and now decrements and checks that length before each parse step: reading sens_res, nfcid1_len, nfcid1, sel_res_len, and optional sel_res. On insufficient remaining input, it returns ERR_PTR(-EINVAL).
intent_record.how: This adds bounds checking while parsing NFCA passive poll parameters so the function rejects truncated or malformed input instead of reading past the end of the buffer, preventing invalid memory access and ensuring only complete fields are consumed.

intent_record.intent_summary: Add input length validation to nci_extract_rf_params_nfcb_passive_poll() to reject truncated NFC-B poll data before parsing.
intent_record.what: The function nci_extract_rf_params_nfcb_passive_poll() was changed to take an additional ssize_t data_len parameter and now adds two length checks: one verifying at least 1 byte is available before reading sensb_res_len, and another verifying enough bytes remain before copying sensb_res; on failure it returns ERR_PTR(-EINVAL). It also decrements data_len after consuming the length byte.
intent_record.how: At runtime, this prevents the function from reading the response length byte or copying the sensb_res payload when the input buffer is too short, avoiding out-of-bounds access and instead reporting an invalid input error.

intent_record.intent_summary: Add input length validation to NFC-F passive poll parameter parsing to reject truncated data and prevent out-of-bounds buffer access.
intent_record.what: The function nci_extract_rf_params_nfcf_passive_poll() was changed to take an additional ssize_t data_len parameter and now performs explicit length checks before reading the 1-byte bit_rate field, the 1-byte sensf_res_len field, and the sensf_res payload, returning ERR_PTR(-EINVAL) if the remaining input buffer is too short; it also decrements data_len after consuming the first two bytes.
intent_record.how: At runtime, the function now validates that sufficient input data is available before dereferencing or copying from the buffer, preventing out-of-bounds reads and invalid memcpy operations when malformed or truncated NFC-F passive poll data is received, and signaling the error with -EINVAL.

intent_record.intent_summary: Add input-length validation to NFC-V and NFC-F RF parameter parsing helpers to reject truncated buffers and avoid out-of-bounds access.
intent_record.what: The patch changes two RF parameter extraction helpers, `nci_extract_rf_params_nfcv_passive_poll` and `nci_extract_rf_params_nfcf_passive_listen`, to take an additional `ssize_t data_len` argument and adds explicit length checks before each byte skip, field read, and memcpy; on insufficient input length, each function now returns `ERR_PTR(-EINVAL)` instead of continuing to parse.
intent_record.how: At runtime, the functions now validate that the incoming buffer contains enough bytes for the reserved byte, DSFID, UID, NFCID2 length byte, and NFCID2 payload before accessing them, preventing out-of-bounds reads and rejecting malformed or truncated NCI data with an error pointer.

intent_record.intent_summary: Fix RF discover notification parsing by validating only the required header bytes instead of requiring the full struct size.
intent_record.what: The length check in nci_rf_discover_ntf_packet() was changed from comparing skb->len against sizeof(struct nci_rf_discover_ntf) to comparing it against offsetofend(struct nci_rf_discover_ntf, rf_tech_specific_params_len).
intent_record.how: At runtime, this relaxes the minimum required packet length so the function only requires the notification buffer to contain fields up to and including rf_tech_specific_params_len, rather than the full struct size. This avoids rejecting shorter valid packets when the full C struct size exceeds the actually required header portion, likely due to trailing variable-length data handling or structure padding.

intent_record.intent_summary: Add bounds and helper error checks when parsing RF technology-specific notification data to reject malformed NCI packets safely.
intent_record.what: The function adds a new length check before parsing RF technology-specific parameters, returning -EINVAL if skb->len is smaller than the current parsed offset plus ntf.rf_tech_specific_params_len and the ntf_type field size. It also updates each nci_extract_rf_params_*_passive_poll() call to pass ntf.rf_tech_specific_params_len as an additional argument and adds IS_ERR/PTR_ERR error handling after each helper call.
intent_record.how: At runtime, this prevents parsing past the end of the received skb when RF technology-specific parameter data is truncated or inconsistent, and allows the extraction helpers to validate input using the provided length and signal failures through error pointers. As a result, malformed notifications are rejected early instead of being parsed unsafely.

intent_record.intent_summary: Fix RF interface activated notification parsing by validating only the mandatory header length instead of the full struct size.
intent_record.what: The length check in nci_rf_intf_activated_ntf_packet() was changed from requiring skb->len to be at least sizeof(struct nci_rf_intf_activated_ntf) to requiring it to be at least offsetofend(struct nci_rf_intf_activated_ntf, rf_tech_specific_params_len).
intent_record.how: At runtime, this relaxes and corrects the minimum packet-size validation so the function only requires the fixed header up to the rf_tech_specific_params_len field instead of the full structure size, allowing valid variable-length notifications to be accepted while still rejecting truncated packets missing required header fields.

intent_record.intent_summary: Add bounds and error checks when parsing RF tech-specific activation parameters so malformed NCI notifications are rejected safely.
intent_record.what: The function adds a length check to ensure the skb contains at least the advertised rf_tech_specific_params_len bytes before parsing, updates the nfca/nfcb/nfcf/nfcv passive poll parameter extraction calls to pass ntf.rf_tech_specific_params_len as an extra argument, and adds IS_ERR(data) checks after each of those extraction calls that return -EINVAL on failure.
intent_record.how: This prevents parsing RF technology-specific parameters from reading past the available skb data and allows the extractor helpers to validate against the declared parameter length, causing malformed or truncated activation notifications to be rejected with -EINVAL instead of being parsed unsafely.

intent_record.intent_summary: Add length-aware parsing and error handling for NFC-F passive listen RF parameter extraction to reject invalid notification data.
intent_record.what: The call to nci_extract_rf_params_nfcf_passive_listen() was changed to pass an additional argument, ntf.rf_tech_specific_params_len, and a new error check was added immediately after the call to return -EINVAL if the returned data pointer is an error pointer via IS_ERR(data).
intent_record.how: At runtime, the NFC-F passive listen parameter extraction now receives the available parameter length, allowing it to validate or bound its parsing, and the caller now aborts processing with -EINVAL if extraction fails instead of continuing with an invalid error pointer.

intent_record.intent_summary: Add a bounds check before parsing activation notification fields to reject truncated packets and avoid out-of-bounds reads.
intent_record.what: A new length check was added before parsing activation notification fields, verifying that skb->len is at least the current parsed offset plus the sizes of data_exch_rf_tech_and_mode, data_exch_tx_bit_rate, data_exch_rx_bit_rate, and activation_params_len; if not, the function returns -EINVAL.
intent_record.how: This prevents the code from reading past the end of the socket buffer when extracting those notification fields from a truncated packet, causing malformed input to be rejected instead of being parsed unsafely.

intent_record.intent_summary: Add a bounds check on activation parameter length to reject truncated NCI activation notifications and prevent out-of-bounds parsing.
intent_record.what: A new length check was added before processing activation parameters in nci_rf_intf_activated_ntf_packet(): if skb->len is smaller than the current parsed offset plus ntf.activation_params_len, the function now returns -EINVAL.
intent_record.how: This prevents the code from reading past the end of the skb when activation_params_len claims more bytes than are actually present, causing malformed or truncated notifications to be rejected instead of being parsed.
